title: Can LLMs replace Neil deGrasse Tyson? Evaluating the Reliability of LLMs as Science Communicators

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: "we assess proprietary models such as GPT-4 Turbo (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09), GPT-3.5 Turbo (gpt-3.5-turbo-1106)"; Table 2 row "GPT-4 Turbo 0.646 0.651 0.193 0.750 0.754 0.432 0.436".

prompt.location: Table 3 (Appendix D.2, few-shot prompts for proprietary models, dagger = GPT-4 Turbo)
prompt.note: Main responses at temperature 0.0; stochastic responses at 1.0 (10 samples) for the secondary metrics.

claim.metric: Main Response Accuracy (MACC) on SCiPS-QA closed questions
claim.location: Table 2, row GPT-4 Turbo, column MACC; SCiPS-QA has 510 closed questions (Table 1)

data.source: GitHub repo llm-science-miscommunication (footnote 1, code and data)

notes: Answers are parsed as Yes / No / I do not know, so no judge is needed for MACC. The verification and hallucination metrics (VSR, Table 7) use GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-3.5 Turbo as verifiers and SelfCheckGPT; the dead gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 only matters for those secondary numbers.
